name: lightsage
description: Turn prompt-run and eval evidence into prioritized, verifiable actions

interface.longDescription: Track how AI assistants and coding agents mention, recommend, and cite your brand, and how well coding agents use your product. Review visibility, citations, and share of voice against competitors, diagnose eval runs that failed or regressed, and get prioritized actions backed by that evidence. For teams that use Lightsage; sign in with your Lightsage account.
defaultPrompt: Review my recent prompt runs and recommend the three highest-impact actions.
Diagnose my latest failed eval and propose the smallest useful fix.
Which competitors do AI assistants recommend instead of us, and why?
